__title: Pricing: the report book stays free · MyWorkLog
__metaDescription: The MyWorkLog report book stays free: AI assistant, PDF in the IHK template, trainer sign-off. The training pass with the wishes from the survey starts at €9.99.
__ogDescription: The report book stays free. The training pass starts at €9.99.
hefte.berichtsheft_ohne_grenze_tag_fuer: Report book without limits, day by day or week by week
hefte.assistent_mit_kestrel_31_turbo: Assistant with Kestrel 3.1 Turbo and Albatros 2.5 Marathon, Thinking to try
hefte.lernt_mit_jeder_woche_wie: Learns how you write, week by week
prWunschU.umfrage_unter_nutzern_oktober_: User survey, October 2026, 10 votes. Next to each wish: where it goes.
prF1.bleibt_das_kostenlose_berichtsheft_: Will the free report book stay free?
prF1.ja_das_berichtsheft_bleibt_fuer: Yes, the report book stays free forever: writing, saving, PDF in the IHK template, trainer sign-off. We cannot promise that for the AI. Every answer costs us money, and how much of it stays free depends on what it costs us.
prF3.was_passiert_beim_vormerken: What happens when I count myself in?
prF3.gezaehlt_wird_nur_wie_oft: Only the number of times a book was picked is counted. No name is stored, no account is created and no email address is asked for. Your device then shows “Noted” so you do not click twice.

prF4.wird_etwas_das_heute_kostenlos: Will something that is free today cost money later?
prTabFuss.das_tageslimit_zaehlt_wie_heut: The daily limit counts the tokens used, just like today. Pass and Plus double it; the AI never comes without any limit.
prVormerkHinweis.vormerken_zaehlt_nur_mi: Counting you in only records whether Plus is wanted. No name, no account, no email.
prTabU.der_pass_ist_fertig_plus: The pass is ready, Plus is still sealed. “New” means built, but only in the pass or in Plus. “Planned” means it does not exist yet.
prF2.wann_kann_ich_den_pass: When can I buy the pass?
prF4.nein_mit_zwei_ausnahmen_die: No, with two exceptions. The size of the free AI quota depends on what the AI costs us. And since November 2026 Kestrel Thinking is part of the training pass, because its models cost several times as much as Turbo; for free there are 3 Thinking answers a day to try it. Turbo and Marathon stay free.
prBaldU.einmal_zahlen_kein_abo_endet: Pay once, no subscription, ends by itself.
prHefteU.das_kostenlose_ist_offen_der: The free book is open, the pass is on sale. You can put your name down for Plus: it counts as a vote for opening it.
prF2.jetzt_auf_der_kaufseite_waehlst: Now: on the checkout page you choose the duration and pay directly. The pass is activated on your account. Plus comes after that.
